clue.text: Speed out of hell, right out

parts.note: out of office or former is EX

indicators.note: right out tells us the letter for right is dropped from the word for hell

parts.note: perdition is damnation, hell

explanation.surface: A demon races out of the underworld and away to the right.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition as a noun can mean promptness or haste, a dated synonym for speed.

clue.text: First wife summoned to court in an agitated state

parts.note: a man's former wife is his ex
someone cited is called to appear before a court

explanation.surface: A man's former wife is served with a summons and gets worked up about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being worked up or stirred up emotionally is the plain sense of the adjective.

clue.text: Worry and uncertainty, say, dispelled gradually?

indicators.note: say signals that the words for worry and uncertainty are spoken, giving something that sounds like the entry

parts.note: worry is FAZE (to disconcert) and uncertainty is DOUBT; spoken together they run on

explanation.surface: Anxiety and doubt are worn away bit by bit.
explanation.walkthrough: Said quickly, FAZE DOUBT runs into PHASED OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something removed in stages has been withdrawn step by step, a figurative sense of dispelling slowly.

clue.text: Biased Democrat is wrong to ignore Liberal and Conservative

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the word for wrong must ignore, leave out, the letter for Liberal

parts.note: criminal means wrong, unlawful
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A partisan politician is accused of wrongly shutting out the other two parties.
explanation.definitionFit: Discriminatory treatment is unfairly prejudiced, a straightforward synonym for biased.

clue.text: Supporter on board includes Prime Minister in tribute

indicators.note: the word for tribute includes, holds inside, the abbreviation for Prime Minister

parts.note: a toast is a drink in tribute to someone

explanation.surface: A loyal backer on the board pays tribute to the Prime Minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On board' means on a ship, not on a company board.
explanation.definitionFit: A topmast is the mast section above the lower mast on a ship, supporting rigging and sails.

clue.text: Propose replacing member of resistance movement?

indicators.note: replacing means putting the letters of the word propose into new places

explanation.surface: Someone suggests swapping out a member of a wartime underground group.
explanation.definitionFit: Anyone who opposes resists, so the question mark makes a whimsical description of one who objects.

clue.text: Pilgrimage held prior to start of jihad

parts.note: had is the past tense of have, to hold

indicators.note: start of means take only the first letter of the following word, jihad

explanation.surface: A pilgrimage is undertaken before a holy war begins.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hajj, also spelt this way, is the Muslim pilgrimage to Mecca.

clue.text: Northern Ireland chief put up once more

indicators.note: in a down clue put up means the letters are written bottom to top, turning both pieces round

parts.note: an aga is a Turkish chief or commander

explanation.surface: A leader from Ulster is nominated for a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: NI followed by AGA gives NIAGA, which 'put up' turns into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Again and once more are direct synonyms meaning a further time.

clue.text: Simple chap given most of work on English TV series

indicators.note: most of means the word for work loses its last letter

parts.note: a job is a piece of work
a soap is a long-running TV drama series

explanation.surface: An ordinary bloke gets nearly all the work on an English television serial.
explanation.definitionFit: This British idiom names an average, rather gullible man, an everyman who gets put upon.

clue.text: Mild reprimand when trial stops unexpectedly

indicators.note: unexpectedly signals that the letters of when trial stops come out in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: A defendant gets off lightly when the court case suddenly halts.
explanation.definitionFit: This idiom means a token punishment, a light telling-off rather than anything serious.

clue.text: Clutch at straws, holding talks

indicators.note: holding means the words clutch at straws contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: A desperate person grasps at anything while negotiations go on.
explanation.definitionFit: Chats are informal conversations, so the plural noun matches talks.

clue.text: Schoolboy's in such a state, turning up with rifle

indicators.note: turning signals that the following little word is reversed

parts.note: to rifle is to ransack or plunder, as does pillage

explanation.surface: A schoolboy arrives with a gun and is in a dreadful state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rifle' is the verb, to plunder, not the gun.
explanation.definitionFit: Pupillage is the condition of being a pupil, which is the state a schoolboy is in.

clue.text: Might they decide who'll win holidays in Bangkok, say?

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase for holidays in Bangkok is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: Bangkok is in Thailand, so holidays there are Thai breaks

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether trips to Thailand settle a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Tie-breaks are extra games or questions played to settle a drawn contest, as in tennis.

clue.text: Socialist secure with revolutionary sanction

parts.note: to pin is to fasten, make secure

indicators.note: revolutionary means the word for sanction turns round

parts.note: to OK something is to approve or sanction it

explanation.surface: A left-winger is backed by a revolutionary's approval.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinko is a derogatory slang term for someone with left-wing or socialist leanings.

clue.text: Servile type offering casual cleaning service?

definitions.meaning: a person who lets others walk all over them
a mat by the front door on which visitors wipe their feet in passing

explanation.surface: A subservient worker offers to do some cleaning on the side.
explanation.definitionFit: A meek, put-upon person is called this, being trodden on like the mat at the entrance.

clue.text: Records calls on the phone

definitions.meaning: registers a sale on a cash till

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both entering an amount on a till and making a telephone call.

clue.text: Reduction in amount of time under the psychiatrist

indicators.note: in a down clue under puts the word for time below the word for psychiatrist

parts.note: shrink is slang for a psychiatrist
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Time spent in therapy is cut back.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrinkage is the amount by which something has shrunk, a loss or reduction.

clue.text: Fashion worn by the retiring mimic opposite

indicators.note: worn by means the word for fashion goes inside, as clothing is worn by a person
retiring means the word for mimic goes backwards

parts.note: the myna is a bird famous for mimicking speech
ton is an old word for fashion, high style

explanation.surface: A shy impersonator dresses in the latest fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link word; 'retiring' is the reversal and 'worn by' the container.
explanation.definitionFit: An antonym is a word of opposite meaning, so the noun sense of opposite fits.

clue.text: Medusa's hideous? That's taken as read

indicators.note: hideous suggests something misshapen, so the letters of Medusa's are distorted

parts.note: the S of the possessive is used here as a letter

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that the Gorgon is ugly and supposes everyone knows it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something assumed is taken for granted, supposed without proof, which is what taken as read means.

clue.text: Artist portrayed mother, using non-U material

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: non-U means without the letter U, which is removed from the word for material

parts.note: tissue is a fine fabric or material

explanation.surface: A painter depicted his mother, working with plain unrefined fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Non-U' is British slang for not upper-class, but here it says to drop U. 'Portrayed' and 'using' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Henri Matisse was a French painter, a leading Fauvist artist.

clue.text: Kid wrapping present that's stuck together

indicators.note: wrapping means the word for kid encloses the word for present

parts.note: to cod is to kid, hoax or tease
here means present, in attendance

explanation.surface: A child wraps up a gift that has been taped together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kid' is the verb, to tease, not a child.
explanation.definitionFit: Cohered means clung or held together, a past-tense match for stuck together.

clue.text: Revolutionary faction coming to the crunch?

parts.note: Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary
a wing is a faction of a party

explanation.surface: A radical splinter group reaches the decisive moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Chewing is working food with the teeth, so playfully it is coming to the crunch.

clue.text: Unconventional person? That's a little bit inaccurate

parts.note: a drop is a small amount
out means wrong, as in a calculation being out

explanation.surface: Someone asks if a nonconformist is slightly off the mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A dropout is someone who rejects conventional society, a nonconformist.

clue.text: Film cast

definitions.meaning: to throw, as a line or a glance

explanation.definitionFit: Shoot means both to film a scene and to throw or send out, as with casting.

clue.text: Work hard on Irish land, rich in precious metal

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Someone toils on Irish soil that is full of gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Ophir is the biblical land from which Solomon's ships brought gold.

clue.text: Martial art event -at the outset, it's announced Yorkshireman was champion

indicators.note: it's announced signals that the phrase is spoken, giving letters that sound like it

parts.note: a tyke is a Yorkshireman, and won means was champion
a do is a party or event; at the outset places it after the opening sound-alike, as the order shows

explanation.surface: At a martial arts tournament a man from Yorkshire is declared the winner.
explanation.walkthrough: TYKE WON is said like TAE KWON; 'at the outset' just says that sound-alike comes ahead of DO, as the charade order shows.
explanation.definitionFit: Taekwondo is a Korean martial art featuring high kicks.

clue.text: Spy's expressed thanks before greeting master

indicators.note: expressed in its sense squeezed out means the word for thanks is pressed out of the spy's name

parts.note: Mata Hari was a famous First World War spy; the possessive adds S
ta is British informal for thanks
hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: A spy says thank you before greeting her master.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Expressed' looks like 'said' but means squeezed out, removing TA from MATAHARIS to leave MAHARIS.
explanation.definitionFit: A maharishi is a Hindu sage or spiritual teacher, a master of followers.

clue.text: Starts to identify duke as head of state

indicators.note: starts to means take the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Instructions to recognise a nobleman as the head of a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is one of the states of the USA.

clue.text: For a Highlander, used one to be short and to the point?

definitions.text: For a Highlander, used one to be short and to the point?

parts.words: For a Highlander, used one to be short and to the point?
parts.note: a Scotsman's weapon: being short and pointed, a stabbing blade a Highlander once carried

explanation.surface: A Scot once favoured being brief and direct.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirk is a short Scottish dagger, literally short and with a point.

clue.text: Decade in women's movement ultimately most important?

indicators.note: in means the word for decade sits inside the other letters

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for women

indicators.note: ultimately means take the last letter of movement

parts.note: the eighties is a decade

explanation.surface: A decade in the history of feminism proves the most significant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Women's movement' reads as feminism, but supplies W and the T at the end of 'movement'.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of weighty, carrying the most weight, figuratively means most important.
